kindDefs.note.fieldIsRow: . The fields of entity and value are rows too
kindDefs.place.head: head
kindDefs.problem.contextBuiltinOnly: {at}: only built-in kinds can have their context overridden (a project's own kind states it in the context of its definition)
kindDefs.problem.contextObject: {at}: must be an object {purpose, use_when, not_for}
kindDefs.problem.contextsObject: contexts must hold {purpose, use_when, not_for} for each built-in kind name
kindDefs.problem.embedFrom: {at}: a line whose base is embed can leave only from a field of entity or value (kinds of from is entity or value and at is row)
kindDefs.problem.endAt: {here}: at must be card (the head), row (a row inside) or symbol (a function or a type inside a file) (got {name}){hint}
kindDefs.problem.endForm: {at}: {key} must be {kinds, at, rows} (kinds is a list of card kinds, * for any; at is card (the head) or row (a row inside; the fields of entity and value are rows too); rows is a list of row kind names, any row when not written)
kindDefs.problem.endRowsAt: {here}: rows (kinds of row) can be written only when at has row
kindDefs.problem.endRowsMissing: {here}: "{row}" in rows is not a kind of row of {kinds} ({known})
kindDefs.problem.endRowsNone: {here}: no card kind has a kind of row "{row}" (in rows)
kindDefs.problem.endSymbolFile: {here}: at symbol (a function or a type inside a file) is written only on an end whose kinds have file
kindDefs.problem.exportAnnotationKey: {at}: when as of export is annotation, key must be the name of a JSON Schema annotation (starting with x-)
kindDefs.problem.exportAs: {at}: as of export must be one of none, comment, annotation, schema (got {other})
kindDefs.problem.exportEmbed: {at}: a line whose base is embed changes the type, so it does not write export
kindDefs.problem.exportKeyUse: {at}: key of export can be written only when as is annotation or schema
kindDefs.problem.exportSchemaFrom: {at}: a line whose as of export is schema can leave only from a field or an element of data (instance) (kinds of from is instance and at is row)
kindDefs.problem.exportSchemaKey: {at}: when as of export is schema, key is the name used when writing it into an element (it cannot be empty)
kindDefs.problem.exportSchemaTo: {at}: a line whose as of export is schema can reach only the head of a form (kinds of to is entity or value and at is card)
kindDefs.problem.fieldCard: {at}.fields.{name}: a field of a line cannot be a card
kindDefs.problem.fieldLook: {at}.fields.{name}: a field of a line cannot have look
kindDefs.problem.fromMissing: {at}: from (a list of where it can leave: [{kinds, at}]) is missing
kindDefs.problem.holdsInner: {at}: "{kind}" in holds can be placed only inside a container ({holders})
kindDefs.problem.holdsKind: {at}: there is no card kind "{kind}" (in holds)
kindDefs.problem.holdsMissing: {at}: holds (the kinds of card it can hold; * for any) is missing
kindDefs.problem.iconForm: {at}: icon must be {name, color} (rewrite the old form icon: "<name>" with color as icon: {"name": "<name>", "color": "#RRGGBB"})
kindDefs.problem.iconFormOther: {at}: icon must be {name, color} (name is an SF Symbols name, color is #RRGGBB) (got {other})
kindDefs.problem.iconName: {at}: name of icon must be an SF Symbols name (lowercase letters, digits and ., up to 80 characters; e.g. folder, checklist) (got {other})
kindDefs.problem.iconsBuiltin: {at}: only built-in section kinds can have their mark overridden (a project's own kind states it in the icon of its definition)
kindDefs.problem.iconsObject: icons must hold {name, color} for each built-in section kind name
kindDefs.problem.innerSection: {at}: the section kind "{inner}" to be made inside it does not exist
kindDefs.problem.kindsObject: kinds must be an object {cards, sections, lines}
kindDefs.problem.lineBase: {at}: base must be embed (the type becomes the other card), designate (the type stays and names the other card) or link (no type involved)
kindDefs.problem.lineName: {at}: a name must not be empty, must have no spaces at either end, must be at most 40 characters, and must not contain : . / , " or a line break
kindDefs.problem.lineSame: {at}: a line kind with the same name already exists{builtin}
kindDefs.problem.linesList: lines must be a list of line kinds
kindDefs.problem.lookObject: {at}: look must be {color, dash, begin, end}
kindDefs.problem.lookValue: {at}: {key} of look must be one of {allowed} (got {value})
kindDefs.problem.maxValue: {at}: max must be an integer of 1 or more, or null (any number) (got {other})
kindDefs.problem.ownerBuiltin: {at}: only built-in lines can have owner (a line a kind of card owns itself)
kindDefs.problem.ownerKind: {at}: there is no card kind "{kind}" (in owner)
kindDefs.problem.sectionActionsBuiltinOn: {at}: only the built-in kinds have actions (a section's actions); a kind of the project cannot write them
kindDefs.problem.sectionName: {at}: a name is letters, digits and _ only, starts with a letter or _, and is at most 80 characters
kindDefs.problem.sectionSame: {at}: a section kind with the same name already exists{builtin}
kindDefs.problem.sectionsList: sections must be a list of section kinds
kindDefs.problem.siblingsBool: {at}: siblings must be true or false
kindDefs.problem.siblingsBuiltin: {at}: only built-in lines can have siblings (a line that reaches only cards in the same container)
kindDefs.problem.sourceOne: {at}: source must be connections or text (got {other})
kindDefs.problem.sourceText: {at}: only built-in lines can have source: text (a line picked up from [[ ]] in the body)
kindDefs.problem.stringList: {at}: {key} must be a list of strings
kindDefs.problem.treeEmpty: {at} is empty (cards cannot be placed unless there is at least one section {tree})
kindDefs.problem.treeItemDirectory: {here}: directory is the working directory's id (a string); left out, it is matched by name
kindDefs.problem.treeItemNeeds: {here}: type (the section kind) and name are required
kindDefs.problem.treeItemPlace: {here}: {label} ({kind}) is a kind that cannot be placed {tree} (it can be placed in: {trees}; see trees in the kind's definition)
kindDefs.problem.treeItemReserved: {here}: names wrapped in _ ({name}) are used by the app
kindDefs.problem.treeItemTreeName: {here}: "{name}" is the name of a tree, so a section cannot be given it
kindDefs.problem.treeItemTwice: {here}: "{name}" is already in project_tree (names directly under the roots must be unique across main and the board, so that they are not mistaken for a path from the board to a card in main)
kindDefs.problem.treesList: {at}: trees must be a list of main and board (got {name})
kindDefs.problem.viasBuiltin: vias "{name}": it is a built-in value (usable without writing it)
kindDefs.problem.viasItem: vias {item}: a via value name must be a string
kindDefs.problem.viasList: vias must be a list of via value names (e.g. ["kafka", "nats"])
kindDefs.problem.viasName: vias "{name}": a via value name is written with lowercase letters, digits and - (up to 40 characters)
kindDefs.problem.visibleBool: {at}: visible must be true or false
kindDefs.projectTree.shape: project_tree is {"main_sections": [{"type": "<section kind>", "name": "<name>"}, …], "board_sections": [{"type": "goals", "name": "Goals"}, …]} (main_sections directly under the roots of main and branches, board_sections directly under the board's root, in the order given)
kindDefs.tree.board: directly under the root of the board
kindDefs.tree.main: directly under the root of main and branches
